say:1:1224401001:1.text: Sonja wants you to come and testify at Tesio's trial later.
say:1:1224401001:1.source_cn: 今天是泰西欧公审的日子。索尼娅特意嘱咐我，请你也去做个见证。
say:1:1224401001:1.male: Sonja wants you to come and testify at Tesio's trial later.
say:1:1224401001:1.female: Sonja wants you to come and testify at Tesio's trial later.

say:2:1224401002:1.text: Do you know where <style="highlight">Sanctum Square</style> is? It's located east of our office at the port.
say:2:1224401002:1.male: Do you know where <style="highlight">Sanctum Square</style> is? It's located east of our office at the port.
say:2:1224401002:1.female: Do you know where <style="highlight">Sanctum Square</style> is? It's located east of our office at the port.

choice_prompt:3:1224401002.text: Do you know where <style="highlight">Sanctum Square</style> is? It's located east of our office at the port.
choice_prompt:3:1224401002.source_cn: 你们知道<style=highlight>颂神广场</style>的位置吗？在港口上面，血薇话事处东边。
choice_prompt:3:1224401002.male: Do you know where <style="highlight">Sanctum Square</style> is? It's located east of our office at the port.
choice_prompt:3:1224401002.female: Do you know where <style="highlight">Sanctum Square</style> is? It's located east of our office at the port.

say:4:1224401003:1.text: Sonja and I have some matters to attend to. We'll be there later.
say:4:1224401003:1.source_cn: 我和索尼娅还有点事，晚点过去。
say:4:1224401003:1.male: Sonja and I have some matters to attend to. We'll be there later.
say:4:1224401003:1.female: Sonja and I have some matters to attend to. We'll be there later.

say:5:1224401004:1.text: You go ahead. I think Sinbad and the Brineville villagers are already there.
say:5:1224401004:1.source_cn: 你们先去，辛巴达和小水村的村民应该都已经到了。
say:5:1224401004:1.male: You go ahead. I think Sinbad and the Brineville villagers are already there.
say:5:1224401004:1.female: You go ahead. I think Sinbad and the Brineville villagers are already there.

say:6:1224401005:1.text: By the way, could you find out if they're up for a long-term collaboration with us? They're really skilled at repairing ships.
say:6:1224401005:1.source_cn: 对了，顺便帮我打听一下，她们有没有长期合作的想法。她们...
say:6:1224401005:1.male: By the way, could you find out if they're up for a long-term collaboration with us? They're really skilled at repairing ships.
say:6:1224401005:1.female: By the way, could you find out if they're up for a long-term collaboration with us? They're really skilled at repairing ships.

say:8:1224401006:0.text: Looks like the ladies have been a tremendous help to you guys!
say:8:1224401006:0.source_cn: 看来她们把血薇帮的活干的不错嘛！

say:9:1224401007:1.text: That's true. Please ask Sinbad for me after the trial.
say:9:1224401007:1.source_cn: 是的。等到审判结束，帮我问下辛巴达吧。
say:9:1224401007:1.male: That's true. Please ask Sinbad for me after the trial.
say:9:1224401007:1.female: That's true. Please ask Sinbad for me after the trial.

say:0:1224402001:0.text: The villagers are here! But there's no sign of Sinbad. Should we ask the villagers about him?
say:0:1224402001:0.source_cn: 小水村的村民果然都来了！但好像没看到辛巴达。要不要找村...
say:0:1224402001:0.male: The villagers are here! But there's no sign of Sinbad. Should we ask the villagers about him?
say:0:1224402001:0.female: The villagers are here! But there's no sign of Sinbad. Should we ask the villagers about him?

say:2:1224404001:1.text: Blanca, is Sinbad here? I searched the square, but I couldn't find him anywhere.
say:2:1224404001:1.source_cn: 村长，辛巴达来了吗？我们在广场上找了一圈都没看到他。

say:3:1224404002:1.text: This is strange... He was just around here a moment ago.
say:3:1224404002:1.source_cn: 怪了……他刚才还在附近的。

say:4:1224404003:1.text: Could he have gone off with some Whispers? As far as I know, he's pretty well-connected...
say:4:1224404003:1.source_cn: 是不是被血薇帮的人叫走了？我记得他认识不少人……

say:7:1224404004:1.text: Actually, that kid's just hiding out somewhere.
say:7:1224404004:1.source_cn: 没那回事，是那臭小子自己躲起来了。

say:11:1224404006:1.text: Well, he must be too chicken to face what's coming!
say:11:1224404006:1.source_cn: 还能为什么，不敢面对接下来要发生的事呗！

choice_prompt:13:1224404006.text: Well, he must be too chicken to face what's coming!
choice_prompt:13:1224404006.source_cn: 还能为什么，不敢面对接下来要发生的事呗！

say:14:1224404007:0.text: It's not about the trial, but I don't know much either since he didn't tell us a word... After all, he's still young and probably hasn't seen a real trial before.
say:14:1224404007:0.source_cn: 不是因为审判，其实我也说不清是因为什么……他也不愿意告...

say:15:1224404008:0.text: You can go in that direction. He should be around the <style="highlight">costume shop</style>.
say:15:1224404008:0.source_cn: 行了，你们往那个方向去找吧。他应该就在<style=h...

choice:13:1:2.text: Isn't the trial what he wanted?
choice:13:1:2.source_cn: 审判不是他一直期待的吗？
choice:13:1:2.male: Isn't the trial what he wanted?
choice:13:1:2.female: Isn't the trial what he wanted?

say:0:1224405001:0.text: Isn't it good that Tesio's having his trial? Why is Sinbad hiding away?
say:0:1224405001:0.source_cn: 审判泰西欧不是好事吗，辛巴达为什么突然躲起来了？

say:0:1224406001:0.text: The costume shop is over there! Let's look for him in this area!
say:0:1224406001:0.source_cn: 前面那家就是服装店！我们在附近找找辛巴达吧！

say:2:1224407001:1.text: Sinbad, what are you doing here? We've been looking for you!
say:2:1224407001:1.source_cn: 辛巴达，你怎么躲在这里？我们找了你好久！

say:3:1224407002:1.text: Why waste your time searching for me? You should be joining the crowd at the square right now—public trials like this don't happen every day!
say:3:1224407002:1.source_cn: 干嘛来找我？现在这时间，你们该去广场上凑凑热闹。公审罪...

say:6:1224407003:1.text: Your tone tells me you won't be coming with us.
say:6:1224407003:1.source_cn: 听你的语气，不打算和我们一起去吗？

say:8:1224407005:1.text: You didn't say it aloud, but that's what you meant.
say:8:1224407005:1.source_cn: 你是没这么说，但你就是这个意思。

say:9:1224407006:1.text: When the villagers said you were scared to face the trial, I didn't believe them, but now I'm convinced.
say:9:1224407006:1.source_cn: 村里人说你不敢面对接下来会发生的事，本来我还不相信，现...

say:10:1224407007:1.text: But I'm puzzled. What could the fearless Sinbad be worrying about?
say:10:1224407007:1.source_cn: 但漫漫想不通。天不怕地不怕的辛巴达，究竟在逃避什么呢？

choice_prompt:11:1224407007.text: But I'm puzzled. What could the fearless Sinbad be worrying about?
choice_prompt:11:1224407007.source_cn: 但漫漫想不通。天不怕地不怕的辛巴达，究竟在逃避什么呢？

say:12:1224407008:1.text: I trust Sonja to be impartial, so the trial is in safe hands.
say:12:1224407008:1.source_cn: 我相信索尼娅会公正处理这件事。所以我不担心公审结果，一...

say:15:1224407011:1.text: With the Carmine Whispers around, Tesio surely won't make it to tomorrow morning. I don't really need to witness the trial.
say:15:1224407011:1.source_cn: 有血薇帮在，泰西欧肯定见不到明天的港口晨雾，我没必要非...

say:16:1224407012:1.text: Can you guys give me some space?
say:16:1224407012:1.source_cn: 就让我一个人，安静地待着，不行吗？

choice_prompt:17:1224407012.text: Can you guys give me some space?
choice_prompt:17:1224407012.source_cn: 就让我一个人，安静地待着，不行吗？

say:18:1224407013:0.text: No, they know I want some alone time.
say:18:1224407013:0.source_cn: 不会的，她们知道我想自己待着。
say:18:1224407013:0.male: No, they know I want some alone time.
say:18:1224407013:0.female: No, they know I want some alone time.

say:20:1224407016:0.text: Chippy will make sure you go with Magister! There's no escaping for you!
say:20:1224407016:0.source_cn: 既然主人发话了，那满满今天就一定要带你过去！放弃挣扎吧！
say:20:1224407016:0.male: Chippy will make sure you go with Magister! There's no escaping for you!
say:20:1224407016:0.female: Chippy will make sure you go with Magister! There's no escaping for you!

say:21:1224407017:1.text: Hey... Hey! Stop dragging me! I can walk by myself!
say:21:1224407017:1.source_cn: 喂……喂！你们！别拽，我自己走！

say:23:1224407014:0.text: Ha, I know you're trying to fool me.
say:23:1224407014:0.male: Ha, I know you're trying to fool me.
say:23:1224407014:0.female: Ha, I know you're trying to fool me.

say:24:1224407015:0.text: ...Since when did you become so clingy?
say:24:1224407015:0.source_cn: ……不是我说，朋友，你什么时候这么需要我了？
say:24:1224407015:0.male: ...Since when did you become so clingy?
say:24:1224407015:0.female: ...Since when did you become so clingy?

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 害怕审判结果不尽如人意？

choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 害怕没有了仇恨，自己会失去目标？

say:1:1224412002:0.text: Chippy saw him heading toward the outskirts. Could he have gone fishing on the <style="highlight">lake island</style>?
say:1:1224412002:0.source_cn: 满满看到他往城外的方向走了，说不定是去<style=h...

say:2:1224413001:0.text: Sinbad's indeed here! Isn't that girl next to him Be—
say:2:1224413001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达果然在这里！咦，旁边的不是贝——

say:3:1224413002:1.text: Shush! Let's listen to what they're saying first.
say:3:1224413002:1.source_cn: ——嘘！别出声，先听听他们在说什么。

say:9:1224413003:0.text: I told you I made the right choice.
say:9:1224413003:0.source_cn: 早就和你说过，我的选择才是正确的。

say:10:1224413004:1.text: Come on. If it weren't for me, you guys wouldn't have caught Tesio.
say:10:1224413004:1.source_cn: 得了吧。要不是我，你们血薇帮也抓不到泰西欧。

say:11:1224413005:1.text: I don't think so. You didn't discover the secret passage, you weren't the one who rescued the villagers, and you didn't catch up with the Chainkeeper.
say:11:1224413005:1.source_cn: 哼，这件事和你有什么关系？发现密道的不是你，救出村里人...

say:12:1224413006:1.text: If you ask me, the biggest credit goes to the Magister.
say:12:1224413006:1.source_cn: 真要论起来，也是那位魔法师<male>先生</male...
say:12:1224413006:1.male: If you ask me, the biggest credit goes to the Magister.
say:12:1224413006:1.female: If you ask me, the biggest credit goes to the Magister.

say:13:1224413007:1.text: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s my friend. I introduced him to you guys, remember?
say:13:1224413007:1.male: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s my friend. I introduced him to you guys, remember?
say:13:1224413007:1.female: Hey, <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s my friend. I introduced her to you guys, remember?

say:14:1224413008:1.text: Friend? Yeah, you're a pro at sabotaging your friends.
say:14:1224413008:1.source_cn: 朋友？呵，是啊，你一向喜欢坑朋友。

say:15:1224413009:1.text: That's not fair! I just have my own way of dealing with things.
say:15:1224413009:1.source_cn: 哪有？我只是有自己处理事情的方式。

say:16:1224413010:1.text: Stop playing dumb. Did you or did you not scare away my fish when we went fishing by the sea as kids?
say:16:1224413010:1.source_cn: 少装蒜了。小时候去海边捞鱼，你敢说你没吓跑我的鱼？

say:17:1224413011:1.text: There was a time you stuck a bunch of straw on my back when I was feeding some pigs. All the pigs came running after me, and I ended up falling over a few times.
say:17:1224413011:1.source_cn: 还有一次，我去帮忙喂猪，也是你往我身上插了好几根稻穗，...

say:19:1224413013:1.text: I remember every time you messed with me before I left the village! I wouldn't have been so forgiving if my father... hadn't admired the captain so much!
say:19:1224413013:1.source_cn: ——我记得很清楚。在我离开村子之前，你没少坑我！要不是...

say:26:1224413015:1.text: ...What did Chippy just hear?! Before she left the village?!
say:26:1224413015:1.source_cn: ……满满听到了什么？！离开村子之前？！

say:28:1224413017:1.text: No wonder she's so close to Sinbad... It also explains the villagers' unusual attitude toward her!
say:28:1224413017:1.source_cn: 难怪她和辛巴达这么熟……难怪小水村的村民对她的态度那么...

say:29:1224413018:1.text: Magister, does it mean Bella's father and Sinbad's father...
say:29:1224413018:1.source_cn: 主人，那贝拉的父亲是不是和辛巴达的父亲一起……？
say:29:1224413018:1.male: Magister, does it mean Bella's father and Sinbad's father...
say:29:1224413018:1.female: Magister, does it mean Bella's father and Sinbad's father...

choice_prompt:30:1224413018.text: Magister, does it mean Bella's father and Sinbad's father...
choice_prompt:30:1224413018.source_cn: 主人，那贝拉的父亲是不是和辛巴达的父亲一起……？
choice_prompt:30:1224413018.male: Magister, does it mean Bella's father and Sinbad's father...
choice_prompt:30:1224413018.female: Magister, does it mean Bella's father and Sinbad's father...

say:31:1224413019:1.text: Is this the story of Bella's past? It isn't juicy at all; it's a bit heartbreaking...
say:31:1224413019:1.source_cn: 这就是贝拉说的过去的故事吗？一点都不八卦，还有点悲伤呢……

say:37:1224413020:1.text: Forget it; I'm not in the mood to bicker with you.

say:39:1224413022:1.source_cn: 还能怎么办？日子总得往前走。

say:40:1224413023:1.text: I'll persuade the villagers to assist you guys in rebuilding Rustport. After all, it was also my father's wish.
say:40:1224413023:1.source_cn: 既然要重振锈锚港，我会劝村里人协助血薇帮的。毕竟这也是...

say:41:1224413024:1.text: Isn't it satisfying to finally get your revenge?

say:43:1224413026:1.source_cn: 那你为什么一个人躲起来？

say:44:1224413027:0.text: Maybe... I just need some time to get used to letting go of my hatred.
say:44:1224413027:0.source_cn: 我也许还没适应……心里的仇恨清空的感觉，给我点时间。

choice:30:0:1.source_cn: 他们应该是一起出海的

choice:30:1:2.text: None of the men made it back.
choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 小水村的男人都没能回来
choice:30:1:2.male: None of the men made it back.
choice:30:1:2.female: None of the men made it back.

say:0:1224414001:0.text: Does Sinbad mean the Brineville villagers will collaborate with the Carmine Whispers?
say:0:1224414001:0.source_cn: 辛巴达刚才说的话，算不算是替小水村答应和血薇帮合作了呢？

say:1:1224414002:0.text: Let's go back and <style="highlight">update</style> Lucca first!

say:2:1224415001:1.text: Lucca, how did the discussion with the Brineville villagers go?
say:2:1224415001:1.source_cn: 卢卡先生，小水村的人谈下来长期合作了吗？

say:4:1224415003:1.text: They were happy with the trial, so we've finalized a long-term collaboration plan.
say:4:1224415003:1.source_cn: 她们满意审判，我们定下了合作计划。

say:7:1224415004:1.text: That's great! Sinbad doesn't have to do the talking anymore!
say:7:1224415004:1.source_cn: 那太好了，看来用不上辛巴达去劝她们了！

say:9:1224415006:1.text: Once all the ships have been repaired, we'll send out an advance fleet to explore the route.
say:9:1224415006:1.source_cn: 船只修理全部完成之后，我们会派先遣队出航，先去探探路。

say:10:1224415007:1.text: And Sonja wants your take on this matter.
say:10:1224415007:1.source_cn: 这件事，索尼娅让我问问你们的意见。

choice_prompt:11:1224415007.text: And Sonja wants your take on this matter.
choice_prompt:11:1224415007.source_cn: 这件事，索尼娅让我问问你们的意见。

say:13:1224415009:1.text: That's right! The magistrate there, General Hogan, is a friend of Magister's! With his help, you can do business with Holistone again in no time!
say:13:1224415009:1.source_cn: 没错！那里的治安官，霍根将军，是主人的朋友！有了他的帮...
say:13:1224415009:1.male: That's right! The magistrate there, General Hogan, is a friend of Magister's! With his help, you can do business with Holistone again in no time!
say:13:1224415009:1.female: That's right! The magistrate there, General Hogan, is a friend of Magister's! With his help, you can do business with Holistone again in no time!

say:14:1224415012:1.text: Sounds good. I'll run the idea by Sonja for her to deploy the advance fleet to Holistone.
say:14:1224415012:1.source_cn: 好主意。我会上报给索尼娅，请她派先遣队前往圣石镇。

say:15:1224415013:1.text: Let's put contacting General Hogan on the back burner for now.
say:15:1224415013:1.source_cn: 至于联络圣石镇的事，不着急。

say:16:1224415014:1.text: Eh? Aren't the ships going to be ready soon?
say:16:1224415014:1.source_cn: 哎？你们的船队不是修理得差不多了吗？

say:17:1224415015:1.text: We have yet to appoint the navigator for the advance fleet. You know, there aren't many suitable candidates in our gang.
say:17:1224415015:1.source_cn: 先遣队的领头人选还没定。血薇帮里，能领航的人不多。

say:20:1224415016:1.text: This is tough, especially when Sonja and you can't be away.
say:20:1224415016:1.source_cn: 说的也是呢……你和索尼娅又不能亲自出海。

say:24:1224415018:1.text: Bella, I'll just say it since you're here.
say:24:1224415018:1.source_cn: 贝拉——既然你在，我就直说了。

say:25:1224415019:1.text: As you have the navigation skills, I'll assign the navigator role to—
say:25:1224415019:1.source_cn: 你懂领航。带领先遣队出航的任务，就交给——

say:26:1224415020:1.text: Not me, Lucca. Please forgive me for turning it down.
say:26:1224415020:1.source_cn: 别交给我，二当家。请恕我拒绝。

say:28:1224415022:1.text: Sorry, but I'm not the right person for this task. Go ahead if you want to punish me.
say:28:1224415022:1.source_cn: 我没法完成这项任务。很抱歉，您要罚就罚吧。

say:32:1224415025:1.text: She isn't one to act willfully. There must be a reason.
say:32:1224415025:1.source_cn: 她不是任性的人，一定有情况。
say:32:1224415025:1.male: She isn't one to act willfully. There must be a reason.
say:32:1224415025:1.female: She isn't one to act willfully. There must be a reason.

say:33:1224415026:1.text: Forget it. We still have time to decide.
say:33:1224415026:1.male: Forget it. We still have time to decide.
say:33:1224415026:1.female: Forget it. We still have time to decide.

say:34:1224415027:1.text: Let me ask her again later.
say:34:1224415027:1.male: Let me ask her again later.
say:34:1224415027:1.female: Let me ask her again later.

choice:31:2:3.source_cn: 血薇帮不会随便罚人吧？

say:39:1224415010:1.text: General Hogan is the magistrate of Holistone as well as Magister's friend.
say:39:1224415010:1.source_cn: 霍根将军是圣石镇的治安官，也是主人的朋友。
say:39:1224415010:1.male: General Hogan is the magistrate of Holistone as well as Magister's friend.
say:39:1224415010:1.female: General Hogan is the magistrate of Holistone as well as Magister's friend.

say:40:1224415011:1.text: With his help, restoring trade between Rustport and Holistone will be a breeze!
say:40:1224415011:1.source_cn: 如果有他的帮忙，锈锚港和圣石镇的贸易肯定不成问题~

choice:11:1:2.text: I can contact Hogan for you.
choice:11:1:2.source_cn: 我可以帮你们联络霍根
choice:11:1:2.male: I can contact Hogan for you.
choice:11:1:2.female: I can contact Hogan for you.

cinematic_dialogue:2:1224409001:.text: Tesio colluded with the Wights and caused the deaths of several villagers.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1224409001:.source_cn: ……泰西欧勾结水鬼，出卖血薇帮，还害死小水村的尤里、霍斯……等人

cinematic_dialogue:2:1224409002:.text: In light of the overwhelming evidence, Tesio's guilt is proven.
cinematic_dialogue:2:1224409002:.source_cn: ——综上所述，证据确凿，泰西欧罪无可恕

cinematic_dialogue:2:1224409003:.text: Under Rustport's Public Safety Code, Tesio's sentenced to death!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1224409003:.source_cn: 按照锈锚港治安条例，泰西欧判处死刑！

say:10:1224410004:0.text:
Finally... Finally!
This day has come at last!
say:10:1224410004:0.source_cn: 总算……总算！\n我们总算等到这一天了！

say:13:1224410005:1.text: Such a tragic end for a mafia boss...
say:13:1224410005:1.source_cn: 唉，一代黑帮教父，没想到落得这个下场……

say:16:1224410006:0.text: Feel sorry for him? You can join him if you want.

say:17:1224410007:0.text: No, I just said it off the top of my head. He certainly deserves this.
say:17:1224410007:0.source_cn: 不不不，我只是随口说一说。这都是他应得的，应得的。

say:18:1224410008:0.text:
Hmph, be careful with your words!
What goes around comes around!
say:18:1224410008:0.source_cn: 哼，祸从口出！\n同样，做的坏事多了，会有恶报！

say:23:1224410010:1.text: Next up, we'll focus on reviving the trading activities in Rustport.
say:23:1224410010:1.source_cn: 接下来，血薇帮会帮锈锚港恢复贸易。

say:24:1224410011:1.text: We'll repair and expand the docks first. Once they're ready, we'll issue a trade subsidy to every departing ship. On top of that...
say:24:1224410011:1.source_cn: 我们会先修建扩大码头，等码头开放后，每艘出航的船只将获...

say:34:1224410015:1.text: We can set sail to do business again!

say:35:1224410016:1.text: It's nice to have the subsidy!
say:35:1224410016:1.source_cn: 居然还有出海补贴，太棒了！

say:40:1224410017:0.text: Wow, sounds like the Carmine Whispers have to shell out a fortune for this policy!
say:40:1224410017:0.source_cn: 哇哦，听起来血薇帮要多花好多钱啊……！

say:41:1224410018:1.text: It's all for the greater good!
say:41:1224410018:1.source_cn: 这是因为，只要锈锚港好起来，血薇帮也会好起来的！

narration:43:12051416:0.text: As the villagers of Brineville celebrate the outcome of Tesio's trial, Sinbad quietly slips away from the crowd.
narration:43:12051416:0.source_cn: 小水村的人见证了泰西欧的审判，所有人都在为此欢呼时，人...
